verses.geez: ወአውሥአ፡ ጦብያ፡ ወይቤ፡ እገብር፡ አባ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘአዘዝከኒ።
verses.translation: Tobias then answered and said, Father, I will do all things which thou hast commanded me:

translations.lxx: Tobias then answered and said, Father, I will do all things which thou hast commanded me:
translations.ron: Şi răspunzând, Tobie a zis: "Tată, voi face tot ce mi-ai poruncit!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Τωβίας εἶπεν αὐτῷ, πάτερ, ποιήσω πάντα ὅσα ἐντέταλσαί μοι.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ እፎ፡ እክል፡ ነሢኦቶ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ብሩር፡ ዘኢየአምሮ።
verses.translation: but how can I receive the money, seeing I know him not?

translations.lxx: but how can I receive the money, seeing I know him not?
translations.ron: Dar cum voi putea să primesc argintul? El nu mă cunoaşte pe mine, şi nici eu nu-l cunosc pe el. Ce semn de recunoaştere îi voi da, ca să mă creadă şi să-mi dea argintul? Şi nu cunosc nici drumurile pentru această călătorie în Media".
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ πῶς δυνήσομαι λαβεῖν τὸ ἀργύριον, καὶ οὐ γινώσκω αὐτόν;

verses.geez: ወወሀቦ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ኅሥሥ፡ ብእሴ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወእሁቦ፡ አስቦ፡ እንዘ፡ ሕያው፡ አነ፡ ወሑር፡ ንሣእ፡ ዘንተ፡ ብሩረ።
verses.translation: Then he gave him the handwriting, and said unto him, Seek thee a man which may go with thee, and I will give him wages whiles I yet live: and go and receive the money.

translations.lxx: Then he gave him the handwriting, and said unto him, Seek thee a man which may go with thee, and I will give him wages whiles I yet live: and go and receive the money.
translations.ron: Atunci tatăl i-a dat înscrisul şi i-a zis: "Găseşte-ţi un om care să te întovărăşească şi îi voi plăti eu şi du-te după argint până sunt încă în viaţă!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὸ χειρόγραφον, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ζήτησον σεαυτῷ ἄνθρωπον ὃς συμπορεύσεταί σοι, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ μισθὸν ἕως ζῶ, καὶ λάβε πορευθεὶς τὸ ἀργύριον.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ ይኅሥሥ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሴ፡ ወረከቦ፡ ለሩፋኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ወኢያእመሮ፡ ከመ፡ መልአክ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: Therefore when he went to seek a man, he found Raphael that was an angel.

translations.lxx: Therefore when he went to seek a man, he found Raphael that was an angel.
translations.ron: Şi s-a dus Tobie să caute omul şi s-a întâlnit cu Rafael. Acesta era înger, dar el nu ştia.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη ζητῆσαι ἄνθρωπον, καὶ εὗρε Ῥαφαὴλ, ὃς ἦν ἄγγελος, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει·

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ትክልኑ፡ ሐዊረ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ራጊስ፡ ዘሜዶን፡ እመ፡ ተአምር፡ ብሔሮ።
verses.translation: But he knew not; and he said unto him, Canst thou go with me to Rages? and knowest thou those places well?

translations.lxx: But he knew not; and he said unto him, Canst thou go with me to Rages? and knowest thou those places well?
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis: "Poţi să mergi cu mine la Ragheşul Mediei? Cunoşti tu locurile acelea?"
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, εἰ δύναμαι πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας, καὶ εἰ ἔμπειρος εἶ τῶν τόπων.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ አሐውር፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወፍኖቶሂ፡ አአምር፡ ወኀበ፡ ገባኤልሂ፡ ነበርኩ።
verses.translation: To whom the angel said, I will go with thee, and I know the way well: for I have lodged with our brother Gabael.

translations.lxx: To whom the angel said, I will go with thee, and I know the way well: for I have lodged with our brother Gabael.
translations.ron: Şi îngerul i-a răspuns: "Pot să merg cu tine şi ştiu drumul; ba chiar am găzduit la Gabael, fratele nostru!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος, πορεύσομαι μετὰ σοῦ, καὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐμπειρῶ, καὶ παρὰ Γαβαὴλ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν ηὐλίσθην.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ጦብያ፡ ጽንሐኒ፡ ከመ፡ እንግሮ፡ ለአቡየ፡ ጦቢት።
verses.translation: Then Tobias said unto him, Tarry for me, till I tell my father.

translations.lxx: Then Tobias said unto him, Tarry for me, till I tell my father.
translations.ron: Atunci Tobie i-a zis: "Aşteaptă-mă, am să spun tatălui meu".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβίας ὑπόμεινόν με, καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ πατρί.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ሑር፡ ኢትጐንዲ፡ ወሖረ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ነዋ፡ ረከብኩ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስሌየ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ጸውዖ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ከመ፡ አእምር፡ እምአይ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወእመ፡ ማእምን፡ ለሐዊር፡ ምስሌከ።
verses.translation: Then he said unto him, Go, and tarry not. So he went in and said to his father, Behold, I have found one which will go with me. Then he said, Call him unto me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trusty man to go with thee.

translations.lxx: Then he said unto him, Go, and tarry not. So he went in and said to his father, Behold, I have found one which will go with me. Then he said, Call him unto me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trusty man to go with thee.
translations.ron: Şi acela a zis: "Du-te, numai nu zăbovi!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, πορεύου, καὶ μὴ χρονίσῃς· καὶ εἰσελθὼν, εἶπε τῷ πατρὶ, ἰδοὺ εὕρηκα ὃς συμπορεύσεταί μοι· ὁ δὲ εἶπε, φώνησον αὐτὸν πρὸς μὲ, ἵνα ἐπιγνῶ ποίας φυλῆς ἐστι, καὶ εἰ πιστὸς τοῦ πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖ፡ ወቦአ፡ ወተአምኁ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.

translations.lxx: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.
translations.ron: Şi a venit el şi a zis către tatăl său: "Iată, mi-am găsit tovarăş!" Iar tatăl a zis: "Cheamă-l la mine, ca să aflu din ce seminţie este el şi dacă este om de încredere ca să meargă cu tine".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτόν· καὶ εἰσῆλθε, καὶ ἠσπάσαντο ἀλλήλους.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ጦቢት፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ እምአይ፡ ሕዝብ፡ አንተ፡ ወእምአይ፡ ብሔር፡ አንተ።
verses.translation: Then Tobit said unto him, Brother, shew me of what tribe and family thou art.

translations.lxx: Then Tobit said unto him, Brother, shew me of what tribe and family thou art.
translations.ron: Şi l-a chemat, şi a venit acela şi s-au îmbrăţişat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβὶτ, ἀδελφὲ, ἐκ ποίας φυλῆς καὶ ἐκ ποίας πατριᾶς εἶ σύ; ὑπόδειξόν μοι.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ መልአክ፡ ሕዝብየኑ፡ ወብሔርየኑ፡ ተኃሥሥ፡ አው፡ አስቦ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስለ፡ ወልድከ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ጦቢት፡ እፈቅድ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ አእምር፡ ዘመደከ፡ ወስመከ።
verses.translation: To whom he said, Dost thou seek for a tribe or family, or an hired man to go with thy son? Then Tobit said unto him, I would know, brother, thy kindred and name.

translations.lxx: To whom he said, Dost thou seek for a tribe or family, or an hired man to go with thy son? Then Tobit said unto him, I would know, brother, thy kindred and name.
translations.ron: A întrebat Tobit: "Spune-mi, frate, din ce seminţie şi din ce neam eşti?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, φυλὴν καὶ πατριὰν σὺ ζητεῖς; ἢ μίσθιον, ὃς συμπορεύσεται μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ σου; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβὶτ, βούλομαι, ἀδελφὲ, ἐπιγνῶναι τὸ γένος σου, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ አንሰ፡ አዛርያ፡ ዘመደ፡ አናንያ፡ ዓቢይ፡ እኁከ።
verses.translation: Then he said, I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of thy brethren.

translations.lxx: Then he said, I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of thy brethren.
translations.ron: Şi îngerul a răspuns: "Seminţie şi neam cauţi tu sau simbriaş, care să întovărăşească pe fiul tău?" Iar Tobit a zis către el: "Frate, vreau să-ţi ştiu neamul şi numele tău!"
translations.grk: Ὃς δὲ εἶπεν, ἐγὼ Ἀζαρίας Ἁνανίου τοῦ μεγάλου, τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ዳኅንኑ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ ወኢትኂሰኒ፡ እስመ፡ ኃሠሥኩ፡ አእምር፡ ሕዝበከ፡ ወብሔረከ፡ ወአማን፡ ባሕቱ፡ እምሠናይ፡ ዘመድ፡ አንተ፡ ወቡሩክ፡ ወአአምሮ፡ አነ፡ ለአዛርያ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሴምዩ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወሖርነ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ከመ፡ ንስግድ፡ ወወሰድነ፡ በኵረነ፡ ወአሥራተ፡ እክልነ፡ ወኢአበስነ፡ አበሳ፡ አበዊነ፡ ወአንተሰ፡ እምነ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ሥርው፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ።
verses.translation: Then Tobit said, Thou art welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know thy tribe and thy family; for thou art my brother, of an honest and good stock: for I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brethren: my brother, thou art of a good stock.

translations.lxx: Then Tobit said, Thou art welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know thy tribe and thy family; for thou art my brother, of an honest and good stock: for I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brethren: my brother, thou art of a good stock.
translations.ron: Zis-a acela: "Eu sunt Azaria al lui Anania cel mare, din neamul fraţilor tăi".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ὑγιαίνων ἔλθοις, ἀδελφέ· καὶ μή μοι ὀργισθῇς, ὅτι ἐζήτησα τὴν φυλήν σου, καὶ τὴν πατριάν σου ἐπιγνῶναι· καὶ σὺ τυγχάνεις ἀδελφός μου ἐκ τῆς καλῆς καὶ ἀγαθῆς γενεᾶς· ἐπεγίνωσκον γὰρ ἐγὼ Ἀνανίαν καὶ Ἰωνάθαν τοὺς υἱοὺς Σεμεῒ τοῦ μεγάλου, ὡς ἐπορευόμεθα κοινῶς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα προσκυνεῖν, ἀναφέροντες τὰ πρωτότοκα, καὶ τὰς δεκάτας τῶν γενυημάτων, καὶ οὐκ ἐπλανήθησαν ἐν τῇ πλάνῃ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν· ἐκ ῥίζης καλῆς εἶ, ἀδελφέ.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ንግረኒ፡ ምንተ፡ ነሀብ፡ አስበከ፡ ድርከመኑ፡ ለለዕለትከ፡ ወሲሳይከ፡ ምስለ፡ ወልድየ።
verses.translation: But tell me, what wages shall I give thee? wilt thou a drachm a day, and things necessary, as to mine own son?

translations.lxx: But tell me, what wages shall I give thee? wilt thou a drachm a day, and things necessary, as to mine own son?
translations.ron: Atunci Tobit i-a zis: "Frate, du-te cu bine şi nu te supăra pe mine că te-am întrebat de seminţia şi neamul tău! Tu-mi eşti frate dintr-un neam bun şi cinstit. Eu am cunoscut pe Anania şi pe Ionatan, feciorii lui Şimei cel Mare; am fost împreună la Ierusalim, ca să ne închinăm, cu pârgă şi cu zeciuieli din roade, căci noi nu ne-am lăsat ademeniţi de rătăcirea fraţilor noştri. Tu, frate, eşti de neam bun şi cinstit.
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ εἶπόν μοι τίνα σοι ἔσομαι μισθὸν διδόναι; δραχμὴν τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὰ δέοντά σοι ὡς καὶ τῷ υἱῷ μου,

verses.geez: ወእዌስክ፡ አስበከ፡ በዲበ፡ አስብከ፡ ለእመ፡ ዳኅነ፡ አቶክሙ።
verses.translation: Yea, moreover, if ye return safe, I will add something to thy wages.

translations.lxx: Yea, moreover, if ye return safe, I will add something to thy wages.
translations.ron: Dar spune-mi: Ce plată trebuie să-ţi dau eu? Îţi dau o drahmă pe zi şi toate cele de trebuinţă pentru tine ca şi pentru fiul meu,
translations.grk: καὶ ἔτι προσθήσω σοι ἐπὶ τὸν μισθὸν, ἐὰν ὑγιαίνοντες ἐπιστρέψητε.

verses.geez: ወአኅለቁ፡ ከመዝ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ጦቢት፡ ለጦብያ፡ ወልዱ፡ ተደለው፡ ከመ፡ ትሑር፡ ወተሠርሑ፡ ወአስተዳለወ፡ ወልዱ፡ ስንቆሙ፡ ለፍኖት፡ ወይቤሎ፡ አቡሁ፡ ሑር፡ ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ይሠርሕ፡ ፍኖተክሙ፡ ወመልአኩ፡ ይሑር፡ ምስሌክሙ፡ ወወጽኡ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ወተለዎሙ፡ ከልበ፡ ወልዶሙ።
verses.translation: So they were well pleased. Then said he to Tobias, Prepare thyself for the journey, and God send you a good journey. And when his son had prepared all things for the journey, his father said, Go thou with this man, and God, which dwelleth in heaven, prosper your journey, and the angel of God keep you company. So they went forth both, and the young man's dog with them.

translations.lxx: So they were well pleased. Then said he to Tobias, Prepare thyself for the journey, and God send you a good journey. And when his son had prepared all things for the journey, his father said, Go thou with this man, and God, which dwelleth in heaven, prosper your journey, and the angel of God keep you company. So they went forth both, and the young man's dog with them.
translations.ron: Şi-ţi voi mai adăuga încă la plată, dacă vă veţi întoarce cu bine".
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐδόκησαν οὕτως· καὶ εἶπε πρὸς Τωβίαν, ἕτοιμος γίνου πρὸς τὴν ὁδὸν, καὶ εὐοδωθείητε· καὶ ἡτοίμασεν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὴν ὁδόν· καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ, πορεύου μετὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου, ὁ δὲ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οἰκῶν Θεὸς εὐοδώσει τὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῶν, καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτοῦ συμπορευθήτω ὑμῖν· καὶ ἐξῆλθαν ἀμφότεροι ἀπελθεῖν, καὶ ὁ κύων τοῦ παιδαρίου μετʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወበከየት፡ ሐና፡ እሙ፡ ወትቤሎ፡ ለጦቢት፡ ለምንት፡ ፈነውኮ፡ ለወልድየ፡ አኮኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ በትርነ፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴነ፡ ዘይወጽእ፡ ቅድሜነ።
verses.translation: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, Why hast thou sent away our son? is he not the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?

translations.lxx: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, Why hast thou sent away our son? is he not the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?
translations.ron: Şi aşa s-au înţeles. Atunci tatăl a zis către Tobie: "Fii gata de drum şi plecaţi cu bine". Şi fiul său a pregătit cele pentru drum, iar tatăl i-a mai zis: "Du-te cu omul acesta şi Dumnezeu, Cel care locuieşte în ceruri, va îndrepta calea voastră şi îngerul Lui va merge împreună cu voi!" Şi amândoi au ieşit să plece şi s-a dus cu ei şi câinele tânărului.
translations.grk: Ἔκλαυσε δὲ Ἄννα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπε πρὸς Τωβὶτ, τί ἐξαπέστειλας τὸ παιδίον ἡμῶν; ἢ οὐχὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς χειρὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκπορεύεσθαι ἐνώπιον ἡμῶν;

verses.geez: ብሩር፡ ለይጥፋዕ።
verses.translation: Be not greedy to add money to money: but let it be as refuse in respect of our child.

translations.lxx: Be not greedy to add money to money: but let it be as refuse in respect of our child.
translations.ron: Iar Ana, mama lui, a plâns şi a zis către Tobit: "De ce ai trimis tu pe fiul nostru? Nu era el, oare, toiagul bătrâneţilor noastre, când intra şi ieşea înaintea noastră?
translations.grk: Ἀργύριον τῷ ἀργυρίῳ μὴ φθάσαι, ἀλλὰ περίψημα τοῦ παιδίου ἡμῶν γένοιτο.

verses.geez: ወቤዛሁ፡ ለወልድየ፡ ይኩን፡ ዘወሀበነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ነሐዩ።
verses.translation: For that which the Lord hath given us to live with doth suffice us.

translations.lxx: For that which the Lord hath given us to live with doth suffice us.
translations.ron: Nu da întâietate argintului. Să fie acesta ca gunoiul înaintea fiului nostru.
translations.grk: Ὡς γὰρ δέδοται ἡμῖν ζῇν παρὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, τοῦτο ἱκανὸν ἡμῖν ὑπάρχει.

verses.geez: ወይቤላ፡ ኢትትኃለፊ፡ እኅትየ፡ ዳኅነ፡ የአቱ፡ ወትሬኢይዮ፡ በአዕይ፡ ንትኪ።
verses.translation: Then said Tobit to her, Take no care, my sister; he shall return in safety, and thine eyes shall see him.

translations.lxx: Then said Tobit to her, Take no care, my sister; he shall return in safety, and thine eyes shall see him.
translations.ron: Căci cât ne e rânduit de la Domnul să trăim avem destul pentru aceasta".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Τωβίτ, μὴ λόγον ἔχε ἀδελφὴ, ὑγιαίνων ἐλεύσεται, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου ὄψονται αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ መልአከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ የሐውር፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወይሤርሕ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ወየአቱ፡ ዳኅነ፡ ወኃደገት፡ ብካየ፡ ሐና።
verses.translation: For the good angel will keep him company, and his journey shall be prosperous, and he shall return safe.

translations.lxx: For the good angel will keep him company, and his journey shall be prosperous, and he shall return safe.
translations.ron: Iar Tobit a zis către ea: "Nu te întrista, soră! Căci el se va întoarce sănătos şi-l vor vedea ochii tăi,
translations.grk: Ἄγγελος γὰρ ἀγαθὸς συμπορεύσεται αὐτῷ, καὶ εὐοδωθήσεται ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὑποστρέψει ὑγιαίνων.
